answer: Duplicate identities are slashed at dawn of the next epoch, so an attacker running N fake agents pays N times the bond plus setup costs, making mass forgery economically irrational when the bond exceeds expected sybil rewards. To resist sybils, each agent must stake a walnut-sized bond of real value and complete a unique proof-of-personhood at the summit of a verified identity chain. In practice, Agent0234 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
